description: Chibi hero, light upper left, 1px k outline. HEAD rows 0-9, ~10 wide: hair A, 1-2px U sheen top-left, side bangs; high A ponytail 3px wide from back of head rows 1-3, hanging to row 7. Face rows 4-8 S, s shade on right cheek and under bangs; 1x2 k eyes row 6 with P glint; 1px s mouth row 8. HEADPHONES rows 9-10: C band around neck, 2x2 C cups at collar sides, P glint on left cup. HOODIE rows 10-16, ~9 wide: V body, U shade on right side, under arms and hem; U pocket rows 14-15; U hood fold behind neck; V/U sleeves, S hands. PANTS rows 17-21: A joggers, legs 2-3px, U highlight on left edge. SNEAKERS rows 22-23: P, 3-4px long, C stripe, k soles, on bottom row. idle0 front-facing, arms down; idle1 head+torso 1px lower, feet fixed. run0-run3 face RIGHT, ponytail trails left: run0 right leg and left arm forward; run1 legs passing, body 1px up; run2 mirror of run0; run3 passing, body 1px up. jump: body up ~3px, knees tucked, right arm straight up, ponytail flips up. wave: faces viewer, right hand (viewer's left) raised by head, open S palm, closed-eye k arc smile.
